title: Acceptance probability of the mixed verifier
statement: Let $n$ be a positive natural number, let $P$ be any property of Boolean strings of length $n$, let $w$ be such a string, and let $q$ be a Boolean proof string of length $2^{2^n}$. The acceptance probability of the verifier formed by choosing uniformly between the property-testing verifier and the coordinate-consistency verifier, on input $w$ and proof $q$, is the arithmetic mean of the acceptance probabilities of those two verifiers on the concatenated input and proof.
hypotheses_covered: arbitrary property of Boolean strings of length $n$
